description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers consolidating multiple already-run judge verdicts into one report (consensus, conflicts, must-fix). Should-not covers near-misses: producing a single judge verdict (the individual judges), dispatching judges (review-changes), code-only review, asking for a quality number, and running one judge.

queries.q: consolidate these judge verdicts into one report — where do they agree and disagree?
I ran the bug, security and artifact-completeness judges — synthesize the findings
which findings did multiple judges flag, and what are the conflicts?
merge the judge outputs into a must-fix / should-fix / advisory split with provenance
give me one decision-ready report across all the judges that ran on this PR
self-review my changes before the PR
give me one overall quality score for this PR
queries.note: opaque single number — explicitly forbidden by this skill

queries.q: run the security auditor on this code
